preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 and 1 <= m <= 30 for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 100, and m is between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= x < n for x in set_elements) for set_elements in all_sets)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input sets are integers between 0 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set_elements) == len(set(set_elements)) for set_elements in all_sets)
preconditions.description: Each input set contains distinct integers.
Every integer from 0 to n-1 appears in at least one set Si for each test case.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.
Each output line is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == min_atoms(n, sets) for i, (n, sets) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the minimum number of atoms required to partition X such that each atom is either fully contained in or disjoint from every set Si.
